data.gender_notes: Gan is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Ganos' meaning 'God's Grace' or 'joy'. In Greek mythology, Ganymede was a beautiful shepherd boy who was kidnapped by Zeus and taken to Mount Olympus to be the cup-bearer of the gods. The name Gan carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גאן הוא שם עברי שפירושו גן עדן או גן אלוהים. הוא קשור למושג הגן האלוהי והמקום הקדוש. השם גאן מופיע בכתבי הקודש העבריים וקשור למושגים של שמחה ושלווה.

in_greek.name: Γάν
in_greek.meaning: Γάν σημαίνει παράδεισος ή κήπος του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γάν είναι ελληνικό και σημαίνει παράδεισος ή κήπος του Θεού. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με την έννοια του θεϊκού κήπου και του ιερού τόπου. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Γάν δεν εμφανίζεται, αλλά η έννοια του κήπου και του παραδείσου είναι σημαντική.

in_english.name: Gan
in_english.meaning: Paradise or garden of God, symbolizing peace and serenity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gan originates from Hebrew and means paradise or garden of God. It is etymologically connected to the Hebrew word 'gan', meaning garden or paradise. The name Gan is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but the concept of the Garden of Eden is central to Christian tradition. The name symbolizes peace, serenity, and a connection to the divine. In modern Christian cultures, Gan is used as a given name, signifying a desire for peace and tranquility.

It brings to mind the story of Ganymede, who represented the youth, beauty, and grace that attracted divine attention. The name might evoke images of grace, beauty, and divine favor in those who hear it.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Gan signifies the grace and favor of God. It reminds us of how God chooses and blesses us in unexpected ways, just as He did with Ganymede. The name Gan also represents the joy and happiness that comes from knowing and experiencing God's love. It is a name that embodies the divine intervention, transformation, and elevation that we can experience when we place our trust in God.
